channel.title: Apollo · Insights
channel.description: Public listing at the original URL; first page of updates, not the full archive. Exact publication day omitted where unavailable.

item.title: Opportunity University: Creating Value in a Changing World
item.description: The Apollo Opportunity Foundation convened 70 executives from 27 grantee organizations at the 2026 Summit for two days of learning, dialogue and shared purpose.

item.title: AI’s Path to $2 Trillion in Revenue
item.description: Apollo estimates AI must reach $1.5–$2 trillion in annual revenue by 2028 to justify infrastructure spending. See the math and where growth could come from.

item.title: Keurig Dr Pepper: The Capital Behind Your Daily Beverage of Choice
item.description: KDP is behind some of America’s most recognizable beverage brands. As the company prepares for its next phase, Apollo is providing tailored capital to help enable its transformation.

item.title: Geopolitical Shifts Are Reshaping Global Energy Markets
item.description: Apollo's Dan Vogel discusses how energy security, supply diversification and rising demand for infrastructure investment are transforming global energy markets.

item.title: Value Creation at Work: How Apollo Supports CEOs Driving Growth Through Times of Change
item.description: Leaders across Apollo funds’ portfolio companies convened to discuss how to drive persistent growth through preparation, new technology and culture.

item.title: From Purpose to Placement: Apollo's Board Service Milestone
item.description: 100% of Apollo's global Partners are engaged in nonprofit board service, either currently serving or actively in the placement process, up from 83% just one year ago.

item.title: Direct Lending: Strong Fundamentals, Shifting Dynamics
item.description: Credit fundamentals remain strong, but rising interest rates, AI disruption and growing dispersion across sectors are reshaping the direct-lending landscape. Apollo Partner and Co-Head of Global Performing Credit Jim Vanek joins host Tal Barak Harif to discuss where we are in the credit cycle, why current market conditions may be creating more attractive opportunities for lenders, and how Apollo is navigating the risks and opportunities ahead.

item.title: Inside the Consultant Conversation: A Q&A with Holly Goodrich and Stephanie Lane
item.description: Holly Goodrich, Global Head of Consultant & OCIO Relations, and Stephanie Lane, Consultant & OCIO Relations Strategy, discuss how consultants and OCIOs are rethinking portfolio construction, expanding into new client segments and building partnerships focused on long-term client outcomes.

item.title: Europe’s Age of Energy Reinvention
item.description: How geopolitics and system constraints are combining to catalyze investment across the energy supply chain throughout the continent

item.title: Cycle, Structure, Selection: Private Equity Portfolios for Today’s Market
item.description: Private equity deal and exit activity have picked up in 2026, but valuations remain elevated and the macro environment is still demanding. How is this shifting PE allocations?

item.title: Infrastructure: Today’s “Generational” Investment Opportunity
item.description: From digital to power grid modernization, from transport to environmental services, infrastructure represents a projected $75+ trillion in investment over the next decade.

item.title: Torsten Slok’s Macro Update: Higher for Longer and the Road to 2027
item.description: As 2026 enters its final stretch, Apollo Chief Economist Torsten Slok joins The Allocation to discuss the latest shifts in the economy and markets.
